summary: StraitsMicro Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based fabless semiconductor company specializing in trusted and secure semiconductor solutions for surveillance, AI vision, RF communications, and power electronics. The company develops advanced System-on-Chip (SoC) products, including AI-enabled processors for surveillance applications, targeting smart city and intelligent edge computing markets.
